description.zh: 待查询的报表ID。如果不传该参数，默认查询所有报表，您可以调用[DescribeDcdnSubList](~~DescribeDcdnSubList~~)接口查询报表ID。
description.en: The ID of the report to query. If you leave this parameter empty, all reports are queried. To query report IDs, call the [DescribeDcdnSubList](~~DescribeDcdnSubList~~) operation.

title.zh: 查询所有定制报表列表

descriptions.zh:
> - 该接口将返回所有定制报表的元数据，不包含具体报表的统计数据。
> - 单用户调用频率：3次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - This operation returns the metadata of all custom reports but does not return the statistical data of the reports.
>
> - The throttling limit for a single user is 3 calls per second.
